description: Different model profiles should preserve bounded Go planning decisions, including direct top-level and exact constructor-result receiver-method evidence, one-hop same- and cross-package dependency evidence, and DTO deferral.

lockedFields.reason: A conventional single-module standard-library test suite should retain the deterministic Go verification command.
Every runtime target in the fixture now has bounded test evidence.
The directly exercised parser, constructor-bound payment-client method, and same- plus cross-package dependencies should remain extend-test items.
The struct-only payment shape should remain deferred from direct testing.
Covered transformation logic should keep a stable extend-test item id.
The parser test must retain its exact package-symbol proof.
The parser result remains consumed by an exact standard-library failure condition.
The module-local currency validator should retain a stable cross-package dependency item.
The currency validator must retain explicit cross-package source provenance.
The cross-package dependency must retain the asserted usage of its parser entrypoint.
The external boundary should retain a stable extension item after its exact constructor-result receiver call is proven.
The payment client must retain exact receiver-method provenance.
The exactly constructor-bound payment client remains directly called by the runnable test.
The bounded same-package dependency should remain a covered normalizer item.
The normalizer should retain explicit one-hop Go source dependency provenance.
The dependency evidence must retain the asserted usage of its parser entrypoint.
The struct-only DTO should remain covered through consuming behavior.
